notizie.titolo: Commission imposes provisional import quotas on hybrid passenger vehicles
notizie.descrizione: European Commission Press release Brussels, 24 Nov 2026 The European Commission today published provisional safeguard measures setting import quotas for certain hybrid vehicles. These restrictions are needed to protect EU industry against a sharp recent increase in imports of such vehicles. The measures will enter into force on 1 December and follow an investigation that showed imports of hybrid vehicles into the EU have increased significantly since 2023.

notizie.titolo: Commission calls for joint EU efforts to reduce tax gaps and boost public finances
notizie.descrizione: European Commission Press release Brussels, 24 Nov 2026 Today, the European Commission published its Mind the Gap 2026 Communication, showing how enhanced tax compliance, improved governance of tax expenditures, better tax collection and more effective tax administration can help Member States protect public finances and create room for the investments Europe urgently needs.
